name: Szukałem Pracy a Znalazłem Miłość
source: Souta in a fresh graduate from an university in Tokyo, and therefore he stands in front of the biggest graduate challenge, finding a job. When getting rejected even by his local fast food, he doesn't have high hopes for his life. At the moment he couldn't have known that, but an inconspicuous meeting with his old friend will flip his life upside-down.
translation: 飒太刚刚从东京的一所大学毕业，正面临应届毕业生最严峻的考验——找工作。当他甚至连家门口的快餐店面试都惨遭刷下时，他对人生已然不抱多少指望。当时的他做梦也想不到，与昔日老友一次不起眼的重逢，竟会让他的生活迎来天翻地覆的转折。
